c_search_bias.comparability_rule: flagged comparable if |corr_random| >= 0.5 * max(|corr_true|, eps), OR both magnitudes are below 0.1 (both indistinguishable from no correlation); PRE-REGISTERED comparison rule stated here since spec.controls.C-SEARCH-BIAS.pre_registered_expectation asserts no magnitude in advance -- this rule is fixed BEFORE inspecting the computed correlations in THIS run and is reported as a diagnostic alongside the raw correlations themselves, which the Coordinator/Validator can re-judge independently of this specific threshold
